registryDesc: Credentials used by Docker trackers to query images on private registries (GHCR, Harbor, company registries…). The password is never shown again.
name: Name
nameHostUserRequired: Name, host and username are required.
passwordRequiredOnCreate: The password is required on creation.
deleteCredentialMsg: Delete the credential "{name}"? Trackers using it will fall back to public access.
threatScoreDesc: Weights used to compute the score and level (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL) of suspicious IPs on the Threats page. The score combines the detected pattern category, the HTTP response code, and the number of distinct paths targeted — a high volume of requests all in 2xx stays mostly harmless, while a low volume in 404/5xx or spread across many paths drives the score up quickly.
breadthHint: Weight per distinct path scanned by the IP
requestVolumeHint: Volume weight (dampened as ln(hits+1), not linear)
thresholdOrderWarning: The thresholds should be increasing (MEDIUM < HIGH < CRITICAL), otherwise the displayed level may be inconsistent.
nameUrlIdentityRequired: Name, API URL and identity are required.
fillUrlIdentityPasswordToTest: Fill in the URL, identity and password to test.
deleteNpmConnectionMsg: Delete the NPM connection "{name}"? Its proxy hosts and their associated uptime/SSL probes will NOT be deleted.
pveConsoleHintIntro: Only needed to open an interactive console on an LXC container — the PVE API doesn't accept the token for this feature, a PVE user with the
nameUrlTokenRequired: Name, API URL and Token ID are required.
tokenSecretRequiredOnCreate: The token secret is required on creation.
apiSuccessConsoleNotConfigured: API connection successful. Console not configured (PVE credentials missing).
apiSuccessConsoleValid: API connection successful, console credentials valid. The VM.Console role will be checked when opening a console on a container.
apiSuccessConsoleFailed: API connection successful, but console connection failed: {error}
fillUrlTokenSecretToTest: Fill in the URL, token ID and secret to test.
deleteProxmoxConnectionMsg: Delete the Proxmox connection "{name}"? All collected data will be erased.
